description.value: Cambie Vietnamese Restaurant has anchored this stretch of Main Street for over 30 years, serving authentic pho, spring rolls, and a broad menu of Vietnamese classics. It is one of a very small number of Canadian restaurants that accepts Bitcoin payments via both Lightning Network and on-chain transactions, verified as recently as February 2026. Touring cyclists on the popular Main Street corridor will find a full sit-down dining experience with delivery partners available for those staying nearby.
